4.4.rationale: Pasal 20(1) in Indonesian includes "menyelenggarakan sosialisasi mengenai pencegahan kekerasan" (conduct socialization about preventing violence), which is indeed an education/awareness activity. However, the judge’s cited evidence was Pasal 20(2), which only lists which OPD sectors implement prevention (including "pendidikan"/education). Merely assigning implementation to an education-sector OPD does not itself establish prevention through education activities. Since the retrieved candidates did include Pasal 20(1)(a) (socialization), the judge could have cited that; instead they relied on a weaker inference from OPD sector listing. Thus the error is primarily the judge’s reasoning/citation choice rather than missing evidence.
